name: Dark Cave
desc1: This appears to be a natural cave, formed by the ceaseless movement
desc2: of the earth and the corrosive qualities of water. Tall, slick
desc3: stalactites and stalagmites make movement a little awkward in some
desc4: places, as do the hundreds of loose stones and boulders littering the
desc5: ground. You can see the imprint of some long, thick snake-like beast
desc6: on the floor, and on top of it, a trail of dried blood.
